title: Hooks are well made, but smaller than I thought they would be.
text: Hooks are well made, but smaller than I thought they would be.. Yes, they have the measurement in the description, but that's the full length of the hook.  The hook itself is small.  They are well made so they still get 5 stars.

product_metadata.title: MJIYA 12 PCS Vinyl Coated Ceiling Hooks Question Mark Shape Hook Heavy Duty Screw Cup Hook for Bathroom Kitchen Wall Ceiling Hanging (Black, 2 Inch)
features: 【Extensive Use】: Great for hanging cups, mugs, pots, plants, hat,clothes etc in Parlor, Kitchen & Garden, Office.
【Loading Weight】: The hooks can holds up around 20 pounds weight, suitable for interior and exterior use.

【Easy To Install】: Installation was easy: 1) find a good spot, 2) drill a small starter hole with a hand drill and just screwed them in place. These were quick and easy to screw in ,hooks are simple and easy to use, easy and quickly to bite into wood, They were nice & snug when they were screwed in all the way.

【Space Saving Optimization】: Wall hanging hooks are ideal for maximizing space. Simple idea but works great and helps to maximize space, provide more space and make the house and garden tidy. Working great for patio, kitchen, garden, office and any home decoration projects. Hooks with a few color options in order to blend in any decor styles.
